c1427635574d.label: {"type":"steps","title":"One piston, four strokes","steps":[{"label":"Intake
c1427635574d.from: Explain how a car engine works.
c1427635574d.text: {"type":"steps","title":"One piston, four strokes","steps":[{"label":"Intake","detail":"The piston slides down with the intake valve open, pulling in a mix of air and fuel."},{"label":"Compression","detail":"Both valves shut and the piston rises, squeezing the mix to roughly a tenth of its volume. Squeezed fuel burns harder."},{"label":"Power","detail":"The spark plug fires. The burning mix expands violently and slams the piston down. This is the only stroke that makes power."},{"label":"Exhaust","detail":"The exhaust valve opens and the rising piston pushes the burnt gas out. Then it repeats, hundreds of times a minute."}]}

b7eefbbf381c.from: How does the human heart pump blood?
b7eefbbf381c.text: {"type":"steps","title":"One heartbeat","steps":[{"label":"Filling","detail":"The heart relaxes (diastole). Blood drains in from the veins, and the atria top up the ventricles."},{"label":"Atrial squeeze","detail":"The atria contract, pushing the last of the blood through the open valves into the ventricles."},{"label":"Valves shut","detail":"The ventricles begin to contract and the inlet valves snap shut. This is the first heart sound."},{"label":"Ejection","detail":"Pressure builds, the outlet valves open, and blood is forced out into the pulmonary artery and the aorta."}]}

38631fd895ab.label: {"type":"steps","title":"How the spin happens","steps":[{"label":"Combustion
38631fd895ab.from: Explain how a car engine works.
38631fd895ab.text: {"type":"steps","title":"How the spin happens","steps":[{"label":"Combustion","detail":"Burning gas pushes the piston down the bore."},{"label":"Connecting rod","detail":"The rod carries that push to the crankshaft, angled so the force becomes rotation."},{"label":"Crankshaft","detail":"Offset journals turn the straight push into a continuous twist."},{"label":"Flywheel","detail":"Stores momentum and carries the engine through the three non-firing strokes."},{"label":"Camshaft","detail":"Driven off the crank at half speed, opening and closing the valves in time."},{"label":"Output","detail":"Torque leaves through the flywheel to the gearbox and on to the wheels."}]}
